full.prompt: Repaint this top-down render of small square parks on mown lawns as a cosy oil painting of a lovely summer day: visible brushstrokes and soft impasto texture, painterly but clear, warm soft daylight, rich but natural colours, lush summer greens. The grass everywhere round the round paved areas is one even, freshly mown summer lawn in a single deep mid green, the same tone across the whole picture: short, fine, even brushstrokes, with no light, yellow or lime streaks, no stripes, no swirls and no patches that stand out. The round paved areas stay pale gravel paving, and water stays water. Plain areas stay plain: no new paths, kerbs or markings. Keep the exact composition: every shape, every tree and every boundary between paving and grass in the same position, size and outline, the same straight-down camera angle. Keep every big letter on a roof or on the ground, such as a green R, C or I, exactly as it is: the same letter, shape, size and colour, crisp and flat, never turned into a sign, a helipad or another letter. Do not add trees, bushes, sky or anything else. No other text, no borders.
